adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group.hbs`, members are rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, which uses the `group-member` item view (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/views/group-member.js.es6`). The item view does not define/proxy an `automatic` property. In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the guard `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}` will therefore resolve `automatic` in the item-view (or member) context, where it’s likely `undefined`/falsey, causing the remove link to render even for automatic groups (or otherwise not respect the group’s `automatic` flag).
